name: Mediastack
rate_limits: 100 requests/month on free tier (previously 500); news has 30-minute delay on free plan
notes: Covers 7,500+ news sources globally. Free tier is very limited (100 req/month) and does NOT support HTTPS — must use HTTP, which is a security concern. No commercial use on free plan. Filters available: countries, languages, categories, keywords, sources, dates. Useful for AI due to structured JSON with pagination, but the extremely low free tier and HTTP-only restriction make it the weakest option in this set. Best used as a backup or for light testing only.
